title: Analysis of Shape Grammars: Continuity of Rules
edition_version: arXiv:2012.10949v3, 14 March 2022; first submitted 20 December 2020; journal DOI recorded separately
relevance: Haridis and Stiny explain how a recorded shape computation can acquire compatible structural descriptions afterwards. Their continuity is a relation between finite topologies of parts, not smooth motion of a drawing.
prerequisites: Undergraduate algebra and linear algebra; additional prerequisites in topic notes

license_redistribution.conditions: arXiv nonexclusive distribution license grants rights to arXiv; it does not establish permission to mirror this PDF in this repository.

verification.scope: Author manuscript, arXiv v3: definitions, mapping selection, worked continuity analyses, computation of topologies and discussion. The technical core was reviewed, with appendices used for context rather than a complete independent proof audit. Manuscript page numbers are used.
